description_full: Nebius Group N.V., a technology company, engages in building full-stack infrastructure to service the global AI industry in the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It offers Nebius builds full-stack infrastructure for AI, including large-scale GPU clusters, cloud platforms, and tools and services for developers. The company also provides TripleTen, an edtech platform for re-skilling individuals for careers in technolgy; and Avride, which develops autonomous driving technology for self-driving cars and delivery robotics. It has a strategic alliance with NVIDIA Corporation to support the expansion of the company's AI cloud infrastructure. The company was formerly known as Yandex N.V. and changed its name to Nebius Group N.V. in August 2024. Nebius Group N.V. was founded in 1989 and is based in Schiphol, the Netherlands.

financial_summary: Nebius Group N.V. is a large-cap communication services business with a $31.5B market cap on $9.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +46% over the past three years and +23% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $241M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.6× net debt/EBITDA, and thin 2.6× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 3.4% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.2× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
